Name: Jonathan, Son of Shimea
Summary: Jonathan, son of Shimea, David's brother, slew a Philistine of great stature with six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, who had defied Israel in the battle at Gath.
KeyStory: Jonathan, David's nephew, slew the six-fingered giant who defied Israel at Gath.
RelatedPeople: King David; Shimea, Son of Jesse
LifeLesson: Defiance answered by a nephew's sword — giants keep falling to David's house.
